name: budget_gate_check
description: Aggregate per-run spend gate (roadmap H5): folds the blackboard's spend facts, decides ok/warn/halt against a ceiling, and enforces the not-startable rule for swarm-mode runs. Spend limit only, never a wall-clock deadline.

correlationId.description: Run/campaign id whose spend facts are folded from the shared blackboard.

ceilingUsd.description: Aggregate USD ceiling for the whole run. Blank/absent/<=0 means no enforceable ceiling (state 'unbounded'); a swarm-mode run with no ceiling is not startable.

warnFraction.description: Fraction of the ceiling at which the gate reports 'warn' (default 0.8).

swarmMode.description: True (default) applies the not-startable rule. False = single-agent mode, which keeps per-agent caps and is exempt.

state.description: Gate decision from accumulated spend vs. the ceiling.

enforceable.description: Whether an enforceable ceiling was configured.

startable.description: False when a swarm-mode run lacks an enforceable ceiling (roadmap H5).

dispatchNewWork.description: True only while below the ceiling and startable; on 'halt'/'unbounded' the caller dispatches no new work and lets in-flight work reach a durable boundary.

ceiling_usd.description: The enforced ceiling, or null when unbounded.

warn_at_usd.description: The USD spend at which 'warn' begins.

report.description: Truthful cost report folded from the append-only spend facts: total usd/tokens and breakdowns by author and by model.
